title: Facilities shift handover checklist and free Excel log
description: Download a free Excel shift handover log for commercial facilities teams. Use the checklist and a worked cooling example to pass open tenant requests to the next shift.
intro: Pass open tenant requests to the next shift with the exact location, current owner and next check. The Excel workbook includes a blank log and a worked example for a commercial building.
checklist: Use one ticket ID for the request. Record when it came in, in site-local time, and identify the building, floor and room.
Summarise what the tenant reported and record any checks or actions already completed.
Identify the person or team responsible. Add the current status, the next action and a due time or check-in time.
Review open items with the incoming shift and confirm who will follow up.
note: For emergencies, follow the building’s established contacts and procedures.
exampleIntro: This example uses a fictional building and request. Times are local to the site.
